featured_reviews.review_text: Smart Bazaar is a convenient place for everyday shopping. featured_reviews.name: Jayesh Mewada
featured_reviews.review_text: I recently visited Reliance Smart Bazaar in Virar West (formerly Big Bazaar) and had a mixed experience. The store is spacious, well-stocked, and offers good variety in groceries, household items, and fresh produce. Prices and offers are decent, but billing took longer due to limited counters during peak hours. Some price labels were unclear, so it’s better to double-check at checkout. Overall, a convenient place for regular shopping, but faster billing and clearer pricing would improve the experience.

featured_reviews.name: Aisha Wasim
featured_reviews.review_text:
This spot is a fantastic choice for anyone looking to grab a quick bite. The extensive non-vegetarian selection is impressive, making it a must-visit for meat lovers. The Korean ramen options are particularly noteworthy; they’re ready to cook and offer a delicious, authentic taste.

In addition to the ramen, the menu features mouthwatering burger and onion ring sandwiches that are perfect for a satisfying meal on the go. The variety of hot and cold beverages complements the food nicely, ensuring that you can find something refreshing to drink. Plus, the range of ice creams adds a sweet finish to your visit.

What sets this place apart is its selection of foreign products, giving you a taste of global cuisine right at your fingertips. Overall, it’s a convenient and flavorful option for a quick meal or snack, making it a top choice for anyone in need of a fast yet delicious bite.

Definitely not worth it! Expected better quality from 7-Eleven.

featured_reviews.review_text: The  experience at the restaurant didn't  go well.  simple requests were not handled properly; for instance, we asked ice for our drinks and it was brought to us almost 10  minutes later that too after insisting. After placing the order, there was a noticeable delay. Additionally, the ambiance did not live up to the expectations at all, as it felt normal not fine dine experience. Altogether, the combination of inefficient service, unimpressive drinks, and an unappealing setting made the visit unsatisfactory and not something we would be like to repeat.
